name: Small Talk
description: The glue of easy conversation — question tags, agreeing and echoing, guessing out loud, and asking things politely.

description_localized.en: The glue of easy conversation — question tags, agreeing and echoing, guessing out loud, and asking things politely.
description_localized.es: El pegamento de una conversación fácil: coletillas, mostrar acuerdo y hacer eco, suponer en voz alta y preguntar con cortesía.
description_localized.fr: Le ciment d'une conversation facile : les question tags, l'accord et l'écho, deviner à voix haute et demander poliment.
description_localized.de: Der Kitt für lockere Gespräche — Frageanhängsel, Zustimmen und Echoen, laut vermuten und höflich nachfragen.
description_localized.pt-BR: A cola de uma conversa fácil: perguntas-tag, concordar e ecoar, adivinhar em voz alta e perguntar com educação.
description_localized.ja: 気軽な会話をつなぐもの — 付加疑問、同意と相づち、声に出した推測、そして丁寧な尋ね方。
description_localized.zh-Hans: 轻松对话的黏合剂——附加疑问句、附和与回应、出声的猜测，以及礼貌地询问。
